research_question: Does an entirely separately sourced, fixed empirical public achieved-motion response envelope abstain instead of confidently misclassifying actual delivered unknown-ACK robot commands, and recover frozen PPO task successes under 32 new PhysX task-truth conditions?

calibration_source.calibration_rule: per-task maximum Euclidean distance of the true achieved-probe response to segment [achieved_before, true commanded target], alpha clamped to [0,1], plus fixed 0.001m; disjoint from new seeds
calibration_source.certificate_claim: NOT a safety/identifiability certificate; four training reset seeds per task do not prove transfer bound

new_frozen_physical_protocol.locked_runner_reference: original physical probe source research/frozen_ppo_physical_response_ack.py from main; replace ONLY cohort/protocol IDs and classification function, no PPO or controller changes
new_frozen_physical_protocol.probe_physical_action: common native 6D zero delta at t=3 following actual executed/neutral-replaced t=2 controller command, preserving previous policy gripper, same for all arms
new_frozen_physical_protocol.model_decision: Public achieved before/after probe XYZ, plus two action-history derived candidate target XYZ. Unique plausible physical response segment under training-only fixed per-task epsilon => choose that history. Both plausible or neither plausible => abstain and STOP before next policy action. No label-based retry.
new_frozen_physical_protocol.privileged_ceiling: Exactly one true target-state read after identical native probe (unequal-information control)

primary_endpoints: All 32 original task-truth conditions with fault and probe reached
Number of public-model decisions / abstentions / model-falsified cases
Number of FALSE confident history authorizations overall and by actual execution truth
Official PhysX task success for five matched arms by true task and fault
Privileged information reads for each arm
Public model response envelope exclusion of the true history, an explicit physical-model failure
limitations: Empirically trained controller response is not independently externally attested physical dynamics or a mathematical correctness certificate
Even 0 observed false decisions on finite episodes would not prove future or hardware safety
No camera, network packet delivery or real robot controller, only official ManiSkill PhysX source tasks
Same Panda target controller and 2 frozen independent external task checkpoints, not cross-robot policy transfer
Third-party independent team execution is outstanding
Not an invented POMDP, minimax or formal-set-membership theorem
